summary: Citizen can save a part-completed application and return later
description: As an applicant I want to save my progress so that I can finish the application when I have my documents to hand. Saved drafts expire after 28 days.

summary: Show a check-your-answers page before submission
description: As an applicant I want to review all my answers on one page so that I can correct mistakes before I submit.

summary: Error summary does not receive focus after failed validation
description: When the form fails validation the error summary appears but keyboard focus stays on the submit button. Screen reader users are not told about the errors. Fails WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.1.

summary: Rotate the case-search API client secret
description: Scheduled secret rotation for the case-search integration. Follow the runbook on the platform space.

summary: Assess address lookup options for the apply service
description: Time-boxed to 3 days. Compare the two shortlisted address lookup approaches on accuracy, cost and accessibility. Output a decision record.

summary: Caseworker can filter the case queue by status
description: As a caseworker I want to filter my queue by status so that I can focus on cases waiting for my decision.

summary: Send an email confirmation with the application reference
description: As an applicant I want an email confirming my submission and reference number so that I have a record. Uses the programme notification service.

summary: Date of birth field accepts 31 February
description: The memorable-date component accepts impossible dates. Should show 'Date of birth must be a real date'.

summary: Caseworker can add an internal note to a case
description: As a caseworker I want to add a note to a case so that colleagues can see why a decision is pending. Notes are visible to caseworkers only.
blockedReason: Waiting for the data protection impact assessment to approve storing free-text notes.

summary: Add the apply service to the uptime dashboard
description: Create availability and latency panels for the apply service and link them from the service runbook.
As an applicant I want to upload photos or PDFs of my documents so that I do not have to post them. Max 10 MB per file; virus scanned before storage.

summary: Case queue times out when more than 500 cases are open
description: The caseworker queue request exceeds the 30 second gateway timeout for large regional queues. Needs server-side paging.
blockedReason: Needs a schema change on the case store, which is owned by the platform team and scheduled for next week.

summary: Welsh language version of the start page
description: As a Welsh-speaking applicant I want to read the start page in Welsh so that I can use the service in my preferred language.
Draft release notes from the merged pull requests and get them reviewed by the product owner.

summary: Caseworker can export the filtered queue to CSV
description: As a team leader I want to export my filtered queue so that I can plan workload offline. Export excludes applicant contact details.

summary: Evaluate an AI assistant for drafting caseworker letters
description: Prototype only, with synthetic cases. Measure draft acceptance rate and edit distance. Human always approves before anything is sent.
